name: cli-agent-runner
description: Launch scoped Codex, Claude, Grok, or user-configured CLI workers, capture their process results, and record normalized process-runner-result packets with separate execution, parent artifact-acceptance, and result-contract outcomes in .cli-agent-runner. Trigger on CLI Agent Runner, Claude/Grok CLI workers, custom runner JSON, or continuation of its workflow state. Primary route: explicit run/orchestrate --runner <id>. Non-use: generic coding and ordinary official-subagent work.

interface.shortDescription: Launch scoped Codex, Claude, Grok, or configured CLI workers.
interface.longDescription: CLI Agent Runner is an explicit process-runner workflow for scoped CLI workers. It bundles Codex, Claude, and Grok profiles, accepts additional or overridden profiles from runner JSON, invokes every profile through one validated command-and-arguments path, captures the configured result source plus stdout/stderr, enforces a machine-checkable repository scope, and records execution, parent artifact-acceptance, and result-contract outcomes independently in a process-runner-result packet under .cli-agent-runner. It does not replace generic coding or ordinary official-subagent routing.
capabilities: Codex, Claude, And Grok CLI Worker Launch
Separated Execution, Artifact-Acceptance, And Result-Contract Outcomes
defaultPrompt: Use CLI Agent Runner to launch a scoped Codex, Claude, Grok, or configured CLI worker and return its process-runner-result.
Add or use a custom CLI runner from JSON for this .cli-agent-runner task.
